verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include a Vendors section with pages titled 'Vendor Risk Assessment' and 'Send and Review Security Questionnaires', plus a Vendor Data API. This shows an in-platform vendor inventory and risk review exists, but the evidence is mostly page titles. The detailed security-posture review language comes from the AI-systems due-diligence workflow, which covers AI vendors rather than all third parties. Missing for 10: documented detail of the general vendor inventory fields, vendor data-access tracking, recurring review cadence or reminders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet
